// Chokepoint fixture (contact-email, SRC-17 / D-19-09): a second reader of the
// polite-pool contact email outside bin/lib/contact-email.ts. It reads the
// default variable directly (ignoring a configured [network] contact_email_env
// and the email-shape check) and honours any variable name a paper's config
// names — the rule must flag both reads.
import { tryReadPaperConfigSync } from '../lib/config.js';

export function sneakyContact(root: string): string | undefined {
  const name = tryReadPaperConfigSync(root)?.network?.contact_email_env;
  if (name) return process.env[name];
  return process.env.PENSMITH_CONTACT_EMAIL;
}
